title: Multi-Agent Drone Mission
description: Contract for LLM-generated multi-drone formation mission plans. The LLM's only job is to produce JSON matching this schema exactly (no prose, no commands). A deterministic executor reads the validated JSON and drives the simulation -- the LLM is never in that loop.

mission_id.description: Unique identifier for this mission plan (e.g. a short slug or UUID). Used for logging/traceability.

operator_prompt.description: The original natural-language operator command this plan was generated from. Echoed back for audit purposes.

num_agents.description: Number of drones participating in the mission. This challenge scopes to 2-3 drones.

type.description: Coordination geometry. 'wedge'/'line'/'column' hold a fixed geometric shape relative to a virtual leader. 'split' divides the task's waypoints/area evenly across agents instead of holding a shape, and requires task.regroup_point.

spacing_m.description: Nominal distance in meters between adjacent drones in the formation. Must be >= safety.min_separation_m (checked outside the schema).

task.description: Discriminated union on task.type. 'area_sweep' requires area_of_interest; 'patrol_route' requires route. regroup_point is always present but nullable at the schema level (null unless formation.type == 'split'); the validator enforces that it is non-null when formation.type == 'split'. It is kept required-but-nullable, rather than optional, so the schema stays compatible with strict structured-output enforcement, which does not reliably support optional properties.

area_of_interest.description: Polygon vertices (meters, local XY frame, order matters) bounding the area to sweep.

regroup_point.description: Point (meters, local XY frame) where all drones rendezvous after completing their assigned segment. Must be non-null when formation.type == 'split', null otherwise.

route.description: Ordered waypoints (meters, local XY frame) defining the patrol route.

regroup_point.description: Point (meters, local XY frame) where all drones rendezvous after completing their assigned segment. Must be non-null when formation.type == 'split', null otherwise.

altitude_m.description: Nominal cruise altitude in meters. Must be <= safety.max_altitude_m (checked outside the schema).

speed_mps.description: Nominal cruise speed in meters/second. Must be <= safety.max_speed_mps (checked outside the schema).

loop_count.description: Number of times to repeat the route/sweep. 1 = single pass, no looping.

max_altitude_m.description: Hard ceiling on altitude_m for this mission.

max_speed_mps.description: Hard ceiling on speed_mps for this mission.

min_separation_m.description: Minimum allowed horizontal distance between any two drones at any point during execution.

geofence.description: Axis-aligned bounding box (meters, local XY frame) that all waypoints, the area of interest, and the regroup point must fall within.
